body.name: Adjacent-singleton cyclic quotient and exact refinements
body.construction: Take \(V_{\star}=\{a,b,c,d\}\), binary alphabets, and \(C_{\star}=\{K_a,K_b,K_{cd}\}\) with \(K_a=\{a\}\), \(K_b=\{b\}\), and \(K_{cd}=\{c,d\}\). Let \(H_{\star}\) have exactly the directed edges \(K_a\to K_b\), \(K_a\to K_{cd}\), \(K_{cd}\to K_a\), \(K_b\to K_{cd}\), and \(K_{cd}\to K_b\), and no bidirected edges. Set \(G_{1\star}=\{c\to a,c\to b,a\to b,a\to d,b\to d\}\) with order \(c,a,b,d\), and \(G_{2\star}=\{d\to a,d\to b,a\to b,a\to c,b\to c\}\) with order \(d,a,b,c\). Finally set \(EX_{\star}=\{K_a\}\) and \(EY_{\star}=\{K_b\}\).
